paragraphs.text: The following examples of Phyrexian text have appeared in official Magic sources.

A proto-Phyrexian language appears on the cover of the Nemesis promo comic. Though the shape of the language appears to match modern depictions, individual glyphs as they currently exist are impossible to make out.
The Phyrexian language was fleshed out in advance of Scars of Mirrodin block . Phyrexian can be found in each scene of the All Will Be One trailer for Scars of Mirrodin .

According to Doug Beyer, there is a system for pronunciation, and the speech heard in this promotional video is accurately pronounced spoken Phyrexian. It is uncertain if the spoken phrases are pronunciations of the corresponding writing. The voice clips were sampled in the Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty official soundtrack song "One With Phyrexia."
Phyrexian can be found in each scene of the New Phyrexia trailer. Presumably, the non-English speech heard is also accurately pronounced Phyrexian.
Phyrexian can be found in the speech bubbles of Dark Discoveries Part 3.

Phyrexian is used for the card text of Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite ( Judge Gift ). The card was reprinted in the Phyrexian Praetors: Compleat Edition Secret Lair Drop, with the type line updated to include the new " Phyrexian " creature type .
Phyrexian can be found in the artwork for Phyrexian Scriptures and in the Magic: The Gathering Arena card animation.
Phyrexian can be found in the artwork for Phyrexian Altar ( Ultimate Masters ).
A copy of Rules Lawyer signed by Eli Shiffrin , former rules manager and Phyrexian linguist at Wizards of the Coast , included a line of Phyrexian.

Phyrexian can be found on a blackboard in the Magic: The Gathering Arena "Training Montage" trailer. A close-up of the text was later posted by Mark Rosewater on his Instagram, and a full-sized photo was posted by MTG Arena on Twitter.

Phyrexian can be found in the artwork for Yawgmoth's Testament . An updated version with a Yawgmoth spelling mistake corrected, two mirrored glyphs fixed, and other small updates was released in 2021.
Phyrexian is used for the card text of Swamp ( Jumpstart , #58 ) and the lore blurb describing the Swamp.
Phyrexian is used for the card text of Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider ( Kaldheim , #333 ).
Phyrexian is used for the card texts of the praetors in a Secret Lair and Historic Anthology V .
Gixian concept art by Jehan Choo features Phyrexian text. The concept was later used for the art of Negate ( Dominaria United ).
The art for Negate by Isis from Dominaria United features Phyrexian text on the figure's clothing and in the spell itself.
There was Phyrexian text included on the bottom of a Dominaria United gift box sent to Magic: The Gathering content creators.
Both Tamiyo and Ajani speak a Phyrexian voice line in Magic: The Gathering Arena .
Gavin Verhey has had "Mother of the Language" Mary Kathryn Amiotte as a guest on his YouTube channel , with her giving details of the Phyrexian language on each visit.
At the end of the Wizards Presents 2022 stream, Phyrexian text appeared on screen.
A Phyrexian language promo version of Psychosis Crawler was created for The Brothers' War Commander Party .
The Brothers' War Retro Artifact schematic version of Bone Saw features Phyrexian text on the right side of its art.
The Brothers' War Retro Artifact schematic version of Mishra's Bauble features Phyrexian text near the bottom of its art.
There was Phyrexian text included on the top of a The Brothers' War gift box sent to content creators.
Packaging for Phyrexia: All Will Be One uses Phyrexian text on its alternate logo.

Phyrexian is used for the card text of Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines ( Phyrexia: All Will Be One , #418 ).
Phyrexian is used for the card text of the Compleat Edition Oil Slick Raised Foil Basic Lands and the text and art of the Phyrexianized Full Art basic lands in Phyrexia: All Will Be One .

paragraphs.text: Phyrexian can be found on the thumbnail and at the end of the Magic: The Gathering Arena Early Access hype trailer.
Clackeys sold an Official Phyrexian Keycap Set featuring Phyrexian characters along with the Latin alphabet and Arabic numerals, as well as some special keys with labels.
Magic: The Gathering Arena includes a loading screen featuring Phyrexian text, an inbox message with Phyrexian text for the header, and an ad for Praetor -themed stickers.
Jace , Lukka , Nahiri (who also has an alternate line reading), Nissa , and Vraska each speak a Phyrexian voice line in Magic: The Gathering Arena .
Phyrexian text was included on the packaging of gift box sent to content creators. Inside contained small cards with Phyrexian sentences.
paragraphs.section: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Gift Box

paragraphs.text: Phyrexian text appeared on an ad for the Welcome to Phyrexia Festival.

MagicCon: Philadelphia hosted a panel on the Phyrexian language, run by Mary Kathryn Amiotte and Bella Guo. They spoke about the structure of the language and some common game terms. Note: The audio samples are from a teaching segment and over-emphasise the individual syllables.
Phyrexian can be found in the inter-titles of the March of the Machine teaser trailer.
paragraphs.section: March of the Machine Teaser Trailer

paragraphs.text: The March of the Machine black-and-white "ichor" showcase version of The Great Synthesis features Phyrexian text near the bottom of its art.
The March of the Machine constellation showcase version of Heliod, the Warped Eclipse ( March of the Machine , #293 ) features Phyrexian text in the top left and bottom right corners of its art.
The Vorthos Cast had Bella Guo as a guest on their podcast , with her giving details of the Phyrexian language pronunciation.

The March of the Machine constellation showcase version of Polukranos, Engine of Ruin ( March of the Machine , #300 ) features Phyrexian text in the top left, bottom left and bottom right corners of its art.
The art for the March of the Machine card Etched Host Doombringer contains Phyrexian text on its face and horns.
The standard art for the March of the Machine card Sheoldred contains Phyrexian text in its background.

Phyrexian can be found in the standard artwork for The True Scriptures . In keeping with Sheoldred 's philosophy of continuing Old Phyrexian tradition, these scriptures are a reiteration of the Phyrexian Scriptures . The ichor showcase art also contains Phyrexian text near the top.
The art for the card Change the Equation contains Phyrexian text in the spell bubble.
A Phyrexian language promo version of Beast Within was created for the March of the Machine Commander Party .
Magic: The Gathering Arena includes two loading screens featuring Phyrexian text.
The prerelease kit for Modern Horizons 3 included an advertising poster for New Phyrexia 's Bloodstained Mire .
Phyrexian can be found in the artwork for the Mystery Booster 2 playtest card Yawgmoth's Day Planner .
Phyrexian can be found on one of the books in the artwork for Creeping Peeper ( Duskmourn: House of Horror ).
Both the regular illustration and the borderless illustration for Scrawling Crawler ( Magic: The Gathering Foundations ) feature Phyrexian text.

In partnership with Wizards of the Coast, Dragon Shield developed a series of Phyrexian themed card sleeves that were distributed exclusively at MagicCons in 2026. While the sleeves themselves do not contain any Phyrexian text, the outter box has Phyrexian on the front and both sides.
The initial release included sleeves for Sheoldred and Urabrask .
The second series release included sleeves for Jin-Gitaxias and Vorinclex .

The Mystery Booster Commander Edition card Valko Indorian includes Phyrexian text in both its art and flavor text as the character represents the in-universe translator of the Phyrexian language on Dominaria .
